title: The Hardys’ return to tag-team gold
summary: Matt and Jeff Hardy’s later TNA chapter brings renewed championship success. Ladder warfare leads to another reign and a final major tables confrontation with Team 3D.

chapters.title: Full Metal Mayhem restores the Hardys
chapters.result: The Hardys defeat The System and ABC to win the tag titles.
chapters.context: The veteran brothers overcome two established teams in a match built around the weapons and high-risk style associated with their history.

chapters.title: The Hardys reclaim the championships
chapters.result: Matt and Jeff win the four-team ladder match for the tag titles.
chapters.context: The Nemeths, The Rascalz and FIR$T CLA$$ stand in their way. Afterward, Bully Ray proposes one last meeting with Team 3D.

chapters.title: One Final Table
chapters.result: The Hardys defeat Team 3D to retain the TNA and NXT tag titles.
chapters.context: The tables match revisits the teams’ shared history and gives this championship chapter a generational-rivalry payoff.
